fiducials.table_frame: Tag centres are in the table frame, metres: origin at the table top's near-left outer corner (outer edge of the trim), seen from behind the robot facing the table; x right along the near edge, y away from the robot. Every label lies flat, text end toward the robot, edges square to the table, so each marker frame is parallel to the table frame. With the table square to the robot, table (x, y) is base (c - x, -d - y), where (c, -d) is that corner from table.center and table.size
